Axis.description: One FITS axis as the file declares it. A status of unresolved means the keyword is absent; the value is then null, never a default.

FitsHeader.description: Header facts the worker read from the file when it was registered. Extra keys may be present and are not part of the contract.

Interpretation.description: What the user declared about the data; the file itself declares none of it.

frame.description: What the angle is measured against: pixel (counter-clockwise from +axis 1 towards +axis 2 as stored) or sky (east of north in the file's own celestial frame). Null means not declared; the file never says.

quantity.description: What the angle describes. A gradient and dust polarization are perpendicular to B, starlight polarization and the B-field itself are not. Null means not declared.

Dataset.description: A registered dataset: a reference to the original file plus header facts. The file itself is never altered.

header.description: FitsHeader when kind is fits, CatalogHeader when kind is catalog

hostId.description: 0 for a file on this computer, otherwise the remote host that holds it

unitDeclaration.description: Present when the person declared a unit for a file without BUNIT. The header's own bunit and bunit_status stay as the file gave them.

kind.description: An image or cube (fits) or a table of sources (catalog, ADR 0044)

catalogDeclaration.description: What the person declared about a catalog's columns; null for anything else

Flags.description: Data-provider channel flags. Flagged channels keep their data; declared false means the file states no flags at all.

View.description: What the viewer needs to lay out a dataset: image size, which FITS axes are x, y and channel, and the sky and spectral readouts with their provenance.

bunit_status.description: declared: the file's BUNIT; user: a unit the person declared for a file with none (never the file's); unresolved: neither

PlaneHeader.description: The JSON header of a plane frame. NaN in the payload means no value, never zero. Extra keys may be present and are not part of the contract.

flagged.description: null means the file declares no flags at all, which is not the same as not flagged.

preview.description: Present on a reduced display preview: not for measurement; the full-resolution plane follows.

UnitDeclaration.description: The physical unit a person declared for a file whose header has no BUNIT. An overlay: the file and its header facts are never changed, and wherever the unit is shown it is labelled as declared by the person.

unit.description: As typed: 1 to 40 printable characters. It is shown and compared as text and not converted.

stale.description: The file's size or modification time differs from when the unit was declared: it may no longer describe these bytes.

Capabilities.description: What this running server can do, so a client can show a feature as unavailable instead of failing on a 404.

protocol.description: Changes only when an existing route or field changes meaning in a way an older client would misread

schema.description: Version of the local data schema

editor.description: The text editor for local files is on (--enable-editor, ADR 0029).

features.description: True when this running server was started with what the feature needs

FigureAxis.description: An axis as the file declared it; null means the file did not say.

FigureHeader.description: Header facts declared by the file and not verified; null means absent.

FigureRegion.description: Pixel region; rect uses x0,y0,x1,y1 and circle uses cx,cy,r.

FigureView.description: What a figure shows. Unknown keys are refused, so nothing else can ride along into a reviewer's view.

spectralUnit.description: At most 16 characters of letters, digits and / * ^ . - space

limitsUnit.description: Must be the file's BUNIT, or the unit the author declared for a file without one

FigureInterpretation.description: The orientation meaning declared for the file, said to be the author's or the import adapter's, never the file's.

FigureUnitDeclaration.description: The brightness unit the author declared because the file has no BUNIT.

RunMetric.description: One measured result of a run, as the run's metadata declares it.

value.description: Null when not recorded; never zero

uncertaintyKind.description: Empty when the run did not say; it is not guessed

RunReview.description: The researcher's own assessment, kept apart from whether the computation finished.

RunSummary.description: The run that produced a dataset, without paths, ids or locations.

DerivedSummary.description: How a derived dataset was made; sources are file names.

params.description: Operation parameters, as recorded; free-form JSON

software.description: Software identity, as recorded; free-form JSON

FigureProvenance.description: Reviewer-safe account of where a figure came from. It has no path and no dataset id.

source.description: The source file by name only; no path and no dataset id.

nature.description: As declared by the author; absent when not declared

Figure.description: Pinned evidence: the picture and the facts it was made from do not change. Title and caption are working text and may be edited.

archived.description: Hidden from the lists by default; still resolves by id (ADR 0041).

scene.description: The scene the picture was drawn from (ADR 0042); absent for figures saved before scenes. Owner API only: it names dataset ids, so it is never part of the reviewer-safe provenance.

previewPng.description: The picture as the author's browser drew it, PNG, base64

etaSeconds.description: An estimate at the rate so far; null when there is nothing to base it on

JobInfo.description: What the owner's board shows about a followed job. A reviewer never gets it.

state.description: unknown when the job no longer exists

progress.description: Present only when the job's log says how far it is

JobBoardItem.description: A panel that follows a job and becomes its result when pinned.

archived.description: Hidden from the lists by default; still resolves by id (ADR 0041).

BoardAddItemRequest.description: Give exactly one of figureId and jobId; both or neither is refused with 422.

BoardPinRequest.description: The figure made from the result of the job a panel follows.

Snapshot.description: A frozen, published version of a board. Optional fields are omitted when empty.

outcome.description: What the reviewer said about this version; empty means not yet reviewed. Not a scientific assessment of any run.

comments.description: Reviewers' comments, not the author's replies

FrozenFigure.description: A figure as a reviewer sees it. kind is omitted for a figure.

FrozenJob.description: A run that had not finished: only its name and state at that moment.

state.description: As of at; it never changes

Frozen.description: Everything a reviewer may see of a board: there is no path, dataset id or credential field.

Preflight.description: What publishing would expose and what a careful author would want to know first. Creates nothing.

hours.description: Lifetime of the link; 0 or absent means 14 days; beyond 90 days is refused

token.description: Shown once; only its hash is kept

TextVersion.description: A text file as the editor saw it (ADR 0029). A save must send these three values from when the file was opened; all three must still match the file on disk.

mtime.description: modification time in nanoseconds since the epoch, as a decimal string (a JSON number would lose digits in a browser)

sha256.description: hex SHA-256 of the file bytes

TextFile.description: A text file inside a source root, opened for editing.

path.description: absolute path of an existing file; a save never creates one

TextConflict.description: The file changed on disk since it was opened. Nothing was written; current is what is on disk now.

Notification.description: One event for the owner. The words say what Slurm or the importer reported; a finished job is never called a success, because it has not been checked.

kind.description: How the job ended (the first five; unknown means Slurm no longer lists it and Vesqira did not mark it finished), or what happened to its results (the last two)

runId.description: The run the results were imported as (kind imported)

unread.description: Unread events in all, not only among those returned

NotificationsReadRequest.description: Mark events read: by id, or all of them. Unknown keys are refused.

AnchorPoint.description: A point on the published picture, in fractions of its width and height from the top left (0 to 1). It refers to the picture as drawn, not to a sky position.

AnchorBox.description: A box on the published picture; (x, y) is the top left corner and (x1, y1) the opposite one, with x < x1 and y < y1.

Comment.description: A reviewer's comment, or the author's reply, in a thread on one figure of a snapshot.

parentId.description: 0 for the first comment of a thread

resolvedAt.description: Set on a thread's first comment when the author closes it

ReviewCommentRequest.description: A new thread needs figureRevision (a figure of this snapshot) and may carry an anchor; a reply names parentId instead and takes the thread's figure, with no anchor. author defaults to Reviewer.

parentId.description: The first comment of the thread being answered

OutcomeValue.description: What the reviewer thought of the review itself; not a scientific assessment of any run.

Superseded.description: Set when the author has replaced this version; the link keeps working.

Review.description: Everything a reviewer's browser receives for one link.

Scene.description: What one pane draws (ADR 0042, section 3): a base plane with its display settings, overlays drawn over it in order, and the part of the image in view. A figure stores the scene it was drawn from. Versioned by schema; a change that is not additive gets a new version.

overlays.description: Drawn in this order over the base, the first at the bottom

channel.description: 0-based index along the spectral axis; 0 for a single plane

SceneSpectral.description: The channel's spectral world value as the worker reported it for that channel; absent when the axis is unresolved or the plane is not read yet. Never computed in the browser.

SceneDisplay.description: How base values become colours. For mapping axial (a declared orientation map) the angles are drawn with the cyclic twilight map, 0° = 180°, and stretch, range and limits do not apply.

limits.description: The custom limits, lower then upper, finite; required when range is custom. With another range the limits come from the plane's finite pixels, and these, when present, are only remembered for switching back to custom.

limitsUnit.description: The unit of the custom limits: the file's BUNIT, or the unit the author declared for a file without one

scaleGroup.description: Panes in the same group share one colour scale (ADR 0027)

SceneView.description: The part of the image in view, independent of the screen: the window of width/zoom by height/zoom image pixels around centre is shown whole and as large as the pane allows.

zoom.description: 1 is the whole image fitted to the pane

ScenePoint.description: Image coordinates: x from the left edge, y from the bottom edge, in pixels (pixel i covers i to i+1). An absent centre means the image centre.

SceneRect.description: Inclusive 0-based pixel bounds, y from the bottom

SceneCircle.description: Centre pixel (0-based, y from the bottom) and radius in pixels; holds the pixels whose centres are within r

SceneOverlay.description: One layer over the base. Orientation, regions, contours, beam and grid are drawn; catalog is specified for a later slice, and a figure refuses it until then. Overlays from another dataset are placed by WCS geometry, never by resampling its data.

OrientationOverlay.description: Orientation lines of an axial map, sampled on its own grid. When datasetId is the base map the lines are drawn from the plane on screen; from another dataset the worker samples that map on its own grid, converts each sample to sky-frame B-field orientation from its declared frame and quantity, and carries position and angle into the base's pixel frame by WCS (never resampled).

id.description: Stable within the scene; actions name an overlay by it

sampling.description: auto: a step chosen so that lines are about gapPx output pixels apart on the base; step: every step-th pixel of the orientation map's own grid. A figure records the step it drew.

length.description: fixed: 0.8 of the sampling spacing; reliability: that length times the declared reliability relative to its 99th percentile (at most 1). Needs a declared reliability map.

opacity.description: reliability: follows a reliability map on the same grid relative to its 99th percentile, faint where unknown; uniform: every line opaque. A figure records which was used.

reliabilityId.description: The reliability map that set the opacities. A figure states it whenever opacity is reliability, and it must be the map declared with the orientation map.

threshold.description: Only samples whose declared reliability is at least this value (in the reliability map's own values) are drawn. Needs a declared reliability map.

color.description: Stroke colour from the overlay palette (design tokens --overlay-*; the image canvas is dark in both themes). Absent: white.

width.description: Stroke width in output pixels. Absent: the kind's default.

dash.description: So overlays can be told apart without colour. Absent: solid.

SamplingAuto.description: A step in image pixels chosen so that lines are about gapPx output pixels apart

SamplingStep.description: Every step-th image pixel; a figure records the step it drew

RegionsOverlay.description: Pixel regions of the base map: the working region, and saved regions with their shapes as drawn (a saved region can be edited later, so its shape is copied).

id.description: Stable within the scene; actions name an overlay by it

ContoursOverlay.description: Contours of one channel of a map, traced on that map's own grid (contourpy) and placed on the base by WCS: vertices go overlay pixel -> world -> base pixel, converting between celestial frames with astropy. Never resampled. Levels are in the overlay's own unit.

id.description: Stable within the scene; actions name an overlay by it

channel.description: 0-based channel of the overlay dataset that is contoured

unit.description: The unit the levels are written in: the overlay's brightness unit as the file (or the person, for a file without BUNIT) states it. Absent when the file has no unit; the levels are then plain numbers. A level unit that no longer matches the file is refused.

color.description: Stroke colour from the overlay palette (design tokens --overlay-*; the image canvas is dark in both themes). Absent: white.

width.description: Stroke width in output pixels. Absent: the kind's default.

dash.description: So overlays can be told apart without colour. Absent: solid.

CatalogOverlay.description: Specified, not drawn yet: markers from a catalog dataset, placed by WCS after converting between celestial frames. A figure refuses it.

id.description: Stable within the scene; actions name an overlay by it

BeamOverlay.description: The beam of a dataset (the base or another one) drawn as an ellipse in a corner of the base, from that file's BMAJ, BMIN and BPA only (degrees, FITS standard), never a default. The ellipse is built on the sky and placed by WCS. Without BMAJ and BMIN, or with an elliptical beam and no BPA, it is refused.

id.description: Stable within the scene; actions name an overlay by it

color.description: Stroke colour from the overlay palette (design tokens --overlay-*; the image canvas is dark in both themes). Absent: white.

width.description: Stroke width in output pixels. Absent: the kind's default.

dash.description: So overlays can be told apart without colour. Absent: solid.

GridOverlay.description: Celestial coordinate grid of the base map: lines of constant longitude and latitude in the chosen frame, generated on the sky with astropy and carried to base pixels by the base's WCS. datasetId is the base.

id.description: Stable within the scene; actions name an overlay by it

frame.description: fk5 is FK5 at equinox J2000

color.description: Stroke colour from the overlay palette (design tokens --overlay-*; the image canvas is dark in both themes). Absent: white.

width.description: Stroke width in output pixels. Absent: the kind's default.

dash.description: So overlays can be told apart without colour. Absent: solid.

unit.description: Only when the file declares it (ECSV meta, VOTable unit, FITS TUNITn). Never inferred from the name.

scalar.description: False for a column of arrays: it is listed but cannot be used as a position, angle or value.

CatalogColumn.description: One column of a point catalog as the worker read it.

CatalogHeader.description: What the worker read from a point catalog when it was registered (ADR 0044). The rows stay in the file.

unit.description: Required: never guessed from the values.

frame.description: A catalog has no pixel grid: the angle is a position angle east of north in the catalog's own celestial frame.

quantity.description: What the angle describes, as for an orientation map. Null means not declared.

sigmaColumn.description: Column holding the angle's uncertainty, in the angle's unit.

format.description: How positions are written. hours_degrees is longitude in decimal hours and latitude in degrees; sexagesimal_hours_degrees is h m s and d m s.

equinox.description: J2000-style for fk5, B1950-style for fk4; null for icrs and galactic.

angle.description: An optional angle column (a position angle on the sky) with its unit, quantity and uncertainty.

values.description: Further columns to show next to each source.

CatalogDeclarationRequest.description: What a person declares about a catalog's columns. Validated against the table; unknown fields are refused.

format.description: How positions are written. hours_degrees is longitude in decimal hours and latitude in degrees; sexagesimal_hours_degrees is h m s and d m s.

equinox.description: J2000-style for fk5, B1950-style for fk4; null for icrs and galactic.

angle.description: An optional angle column (a position angle on the sky) with its unit, quantity and uncertainty.

values.description: Further columns to show next to each source.

stale.description: True when the file's size or modification time differs from when this was declared. A stale declaration is not applied: positions are refused until it is confirmed again.

CatalogDeclaration.description: An overlay: the file and the columns the worker read are never changed.

path.description: Absolute path inside a source root; resolved and authorised like a FITS registration

basis.description: Always shown with the proposal. A proposal is never stored or applied until the person confirms it.

notes.description: What the names do not settle, for the person to choose.

placed.description: Rows whose longitude and latitude were both read

unreadable.description: Rows with a longitude or latitude that is there but cannot be read; counted over the whole table

missing.description: Rows with an empty longitude or latitude (not the same as unreadable), not counted above

line.description: 1-based line of the file (text tables); null for VOTable and FITS

value.description: At most 40 characters of the value

samples.description: The first unreadable values, with their line

line.description: 1-based line of the file (text tables); null for VOTable and FITS

value.description: At most 40 characters of the value

line.description: 1-based line of the file (text tables); null for VOTable and FITS

value.description: At most 40 characters of the value

line.description: 1-based line of the file (text tables); null for VOTable and FITS

value.description: At most 40 characters of the value

line.description: 1-based line of the file (text tables); null for VOTable and FITS

value.description: At most 40 characters of the value

preview.description: The first rows. A missing value is null, never 0; text is cut at 64 characters.

skippedTotal.description: Lines that are not rows (wrong number of fields); each is listed with its line

parse.description: Present when a fresh declaration is in force

parseError.description: Why the declaration could not be applied (stale, or too many sexagesimal values to place)

rows.description: Cells in column order; null is a missing value or a column of arrays

lines.description: The file line of each row (text tables)

lon.description: Degrees in [0, 360); null for a row whose position could not be read, never 0

angle.description: Position angle in degrees east of north, in [0, 180) for an orientation quantity; null where missing

CatalogPositions.description: Positions in the declared frame, or in the frame asked for (transformed with astropy, angles carried with them).

scope.description: storage pool, file system or mount the line is about

softBytes.description: null: the tool reports no soft limit

hardBytes.description: null: the tool reports no hard limit

raw.description: the line as the tool printed it (shortened), so the numbers can be compared with the cluster's own

QuotaEntry.description: One line of a quota report. Sizes are powers of 1024, which is what each tool prints.

tool.description: which tool answered; tried in this order

root.description: one of the host's declared source roots

error.description: present when df gave nothing usable for this root; the numbers are then 0 and mean nothing

HostFilesystem.description: What `df -P -k` reported for a root. Free space is the file system's, not the user's allowance.

quota.description: null when no quota tool answered readably

quotaNote.description: when quota is null: "this site's quota tool is not available", in words

report.description: the last good look; null if there has never been one

error.description: non-empty when the latest attempt failed (host unreachable); report is then the last good look, if any

cached.description: true when no call was made to the host for this answer

HostStorage.description: Quota and disk usage of a host (ADR 0045). A look is reused for 10 minutes; a failed one for 1 minute; Refresh cannot reach the host more than once per 15 seconds.

kind.description: a job's output folder, or a run folder found by scanning a project on the host

bytes.description: null until measured; never 0 for unmeasured

partial.description: du could not read some entries, so bytes is a lower bound

RunFolderList.description: Run folders on a host, largest measured first. Listing makes no call to the host.

path.description: an absolute folder inside one of the host's source roots

partial.description: du could not read some entries: a lower bound

DiskUsage.description: `du -sk` of one folder: disk blocks used, not the sum of file lengths.

RelativeOrientationParams.description: Each is optional; the default is stated in the result's parameters (ADR 0047).

radiusArcmin.description: Map vs catalog only: disk radius on the sky (default 10)

minPixels.description: Map vs catalog only: fewest usable pixels in a disk (default 5)

nShifts.description: Null shifts (default 3000 for a catalog, 1000 for two maps; 0 for none)

keepFraction.description: A shift is kept when this share of the real samples stays usable (default 0.9)

seed.description: Seed of the null's random stream (default 20261020); recorded in the result

snrColumn.description: Map vs catalog only: the declared value column holding P, for the optional filter P/σP ≥ snrMin; off unless both columns are named

snrSigmaColumn.description: Map vs catalog only: the declared value column holding σP

snrMin.description: The filter's k (default 3, the threshold the owner's comparison script uses); rows with P/σP below it are excluded and counted, rows with P or σP missing are excluded with their own reason

datasetId.description: A map declared as an axial orientation map, with its frame and quantity

otherId.description: A point catalog with a declared angle, or a second declared orientation map on the same grid

RelativeOrientationSummary.description: Every number with its definition, the parameters as used (defaults filled in, seed included), counts and exclusions (ADR 0047).

map.description: The map's declaration as used (unit, frame, quantity, rotation to B, celestial frame, reliability), its size nx, ny and pixel scale

other.description: The second map's declaration as used (map vs map)

catalog.description: The catalog's frame, angle quantity, rotation to B, row count and uncertainty column (map vs catalog)

snr_filter.description: The P/σP filter as applied (columns, k, rule, rows excluded below k and for missing values); null when it was off

LevelsSigma.description: Levels at multiples of a robust noise estimate of the contoured channel: sigma = 1.4826 x MAD of its finite pixels (astropy.stats.mad_std). It is the scatter of the whole plane, signal included, and is labelled as such.

sigma.description: The sigma the levels were drawn with, recorded by a figure. A recomputed sigma that differs is refused (the data changed).

OverlayGeometryRequest.description: Geometry of one overlay on the base dataset named in the path.

spacing.description: For orientation with auto sampling: the wanted distance between lines, in base pixels (the pane's gapPx divided by its scale). Ignored otherwise.

OverlayGeometryHeader.description: The JSON header of an overlay geometry frame. Every position is in base pixels: 0-based, pixel centres at integers, y up (FITS order). Extra keys may be present and are not part of the contract.

paths.description: contours, beam, grid: the payload starts with paths pairs (group, vertex count) and continues with the vertices as (x, y) pairs. group is the level index (contours), 0 for the beam, 0 for a line of constant longitude and 1 for one of constant latitude (grid).

segments.description: orientation: the payload is segments quadruples (x, y, angle, weight): angle in degrees counter-clockwise from the base's +x pixel axis towards +y, weight in [0, 1] (1 without a reliability map).

placement.description: How the overlay was placed on the base.

levels.description: contours: the levels traced, in unit

simplified.description: Present when the vertices were over budget and simplified (Ramer-Douglas-Peucker) with this tolerance in base pixels.

step.description: orientation: the sampling step used, in overlay pixels

spacing_px.description: orientation: the distance between samples in base pixels

conversion.description: orientation: how the stored angles became B-field orientation in the base pixel frame

reliability.description: orientation: present when the declared reliability map was read (for length, opacity or a threshold)

nGauss.description: Gaussians per pixel, as the run's records declare; 0 when they do not

isCrop.description: the dataset is the crop the fit used

refusal.description: why the components cannot be drawn over this dataset

RohsaRunView.description: A ROHSA decomposition run whose components could be drawn over a dataset: the dataset is the run's crop or exactly on its grid. A cube with the crop's axis lengths but another (or unconfirmed) grid is listed with the reason it is refused.

index_bytes.description: size of the sidecar index: 8 bytes per pixel

RohsaIndexState.description: Progress of the index of a ROHSA .dat. building: call again; ready: pixels can be read; refused: the file is not the ROHSA row layout, with the reason and example lines.

k.description: 1-based Gaussian number within the pixel, in file order

amp.description: fitted amplitude in the crop's brightness unit; 0 is a real value

mean_channel.description: 0-based channel index: the file's value minus 1

valid.description: false when sigma is not positive and finite; such a component is not drawn

centre.description: km/s on the crop's spectral axis; null without a resolved velocity axis

t_doppler_k.description: 121.1 K (km/s)^-2 x sigma^2: an upper limit on the kinetic temperature

conventions.description: the conventions applied, in words: columns, 1-based mean, sigma, model, invalid components, FWHM, T_D

RohsaComponentsHeader.description: The JSON header of a rohsa components frame.

GET /api/datasets/{id}/plane.summary: One plane as a binary frame
GET /api/datasets/{id}/plane.description: Frame layout: uint32 little-endian header length n, then n bytes of JSON (a PlaneHeader, padded with spaces so the payload is 8-byte aligned), then width*height little-endian float32 pixels, row-major, row 0 = FITS y=1. Non-finite means no value. Only the transport and the JSON header are described here, not the binary payload.

404.description: Unknown, expired or revoked link (always the same body)

429.description: Too many failed links from this address; plain text, not the Error shape

default.description: Plain text, not the Error shape: 400 (bad body), 415 (not application/json), 500

GET /api/snapshots/{id}/comments.summary: Comments on a published snapshot, for its author

POST /api/snapshots/{id}/comments.summary: The author replies inside a reviewer's thread

POST /api/snapshots/{id}/revoke.summary: End a review link; the snapshot and its comments stay readable to the author

POST /api/comments/{id}/resolve.summary: Close or reopen a thread (author only; the id is a thread's first comment)

POST /api/catalogs.summary: Register a file as a point catalog (a table of sources); the path is authorised like a FITS registration

422.description: not a readable table, or over the size, row or column limits

GET /api/datasets/{id}/catalog/report.summary: How a catalog was read, what its column names suggest, and how its declaration reads every row

409.description: not a catalog, or the file changed since it was registered

GET /api/datasets/{id}/catalog/rows.summary: A page of a catalog's rows (at most 500)

GET /api/datasets/{id}/catalog/positions.summary: Sky positions of a catalog's rows from its declaration, optionally transformed to another frame

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Transform to this frame (icrs, fk5, fk4, galactic)

409.description: no declaration, or a stale one: the response names what is missing

PUT /api/datasets/{id}/catalog/declarati.summary: Declare a catalog's columns (positions, format, frame, optional angle and values); validated, never inferred

400.description: incomplete or inconsistent; reasons lists each problem

GET /api/hosts/{id}/storage.summary: Quota and disk usage of a host, from a cache of at most 10 minutes (owner listener only)

POST /api/hosts/{id}/storage/refresh.summary: Look at the host's storage again now (at most once per 15 seconds per host)

GET /api/hosts/{id}/folders.summary: Run folders on a host (job outputs, scanned runs) with the sizes measured so far; no call to the host

POST /api/hosts/{id}/folders/size.summary: Measure one folder with du -sk (read-only; one at a time per host; 90 s limit)

422.description: not a folder inside the host's source roots

502.description: the host did not answer, du timed out, or the folder is not there

POST /api/analysis/relative-orientation.summary: Relative orientation of a declared orientation map against a catalog or a second map: alignment measure, projected Rayleigh statistic, histogram and a shifted null; the result is registered with its provenance

201.description: computed and registered (the per-source table for a catalog, the |Δψ| map for two maps)

409.description: a stale declaration, data on another host, or two maps not known to share a grid (reasons listed)

422.description: a missing declaration (named), or the worker refused (for example no source could be compared)

GET /api/datasets/{id}/relative-orientat.summary: The per-sample table of a relative-orientation result as CSV (missing values are empty cells)

404.description: not a relative-orientation result, or no table (a map comparison over the row limit)

POST /api/datasets/{id}/overlay-geometry.summary: Geometry of one overlay on this dataset as base, as a binary frame
POST /api/datasets/{id}/overlay-geometry.description: Both datasets must be readable and unchanged, and on the same machine. Frame layout as for a plane: uint32 little-endian header length n, n bytes of JSON (an OverlayGeometryHeader, padded so the payload is 8-byte aligned), then little-endian float32 numbers laid out as the header says. A refusal (frames that cannot be related, footprints that do not overlap, an undeclared angle convention, no beam in the header) is a 422 with the reason.

GET /api/datasets/{id}/rohsa.summary: ROHSA decomposition runs whose Gaussian components can be drawn over this dataset

POST /api/datasets/{id}/rohsa/index.summary: Advance (or confirm) the index of a run's .dat; each call works for a bounded time

409.description: the dataset is not on the run's grid (the reasons are listed), or the run has no crop

GET /api/datasets/{id}/rohsa/components.summary: The Gaussian components of one pixel as a binary frame
GET /api/datasets/{id}/rohsa/components.description: Frame layout as for a plane: uint32 little-endian header length n, then n bytes of JSON (a RohsaComponentsHeader, padded with spaces), then little-endian float64 axis[channels] (km/s, or channel numbers when the spectral axis is not a resolved velocity), model[channels] (the sum of the valid components) and component[n_gauss][channels]. 409 until the .dat is indexed (see the index route) or when the dataset is not on the run's grid.

409.description: not indexed yet, or the dataset is not on the run's grid
